svg.aria-label: A second interface, chosen per pod: 1. Attach: A pod names the multus-iot network in its annotation. Multus adds the interface, leaving eth0 on Cilium. 2. Macvlan: The macvlan plugin puts net1 directly on bond0.3, so the pod has an address on the IoT VLAN. 3. Address: Static IPAM assigns the address from the pod annotation. The default route goes to the IoT gateway. 4. Return path: The sbr plugin keeps replies leaving on the interface they arrived on, so both networks stay reachable.
